# Astronomical 0.2.75
## Fixed
- **Restart server now recovers by itself and explains failures.** Restarting the server could leave it dead with a generic banner when the fresh server process raced the previous one's shutdown and lost the instance lock. The menu now waits for the previous server to release the lock, retries the respawn, captures the server's startup output, and shows the server's own explanation in the banner when a start truly fails. Failed early startup is also recorded under the instance state directory (`logs/startup-failures.log`, `last-startup-failure.json`), and the running server writes its process id into the instance lock file so lock conflicts can be attributed.
## Improved
- **The memory panel names the macOS GPU lock limit.** The MLX memory panel now shows the wired-residency budget macOS actually grants the GPU. When the configured maximum model RAM exceeds that lock limit, the panel draws the limit as its own line and caps the stepper at it, so on-screen numbers match what the GPU can really reserve.
## Compatibility
- No configuration changes; existing state directories, models, and client workflows keep working. The new startup-failure files are created on demand inside the instance state directory.
## Distribution
- Signed with the Developer ID Application identity, notarized, and stapled. The Sparkle appcast and enclosure are signed by the release tooling; existing installs receive the update through the normal Sparkle channel.
